title: validateReport asserts validation it does not perform
description: Method named validateReport returns string (report.title) instead of validation result. Repo baseline: methods name exactly what they do (isOverdue, hasRows, exportCsv). Fix: drop method and read report.title at call site, or rename to reportTitle(report: Report): string.

title: New class and its methods diverge from the repo's naming idiom
description: ReportManager doesn't follow <Noun>Service convention (InvoiceService, ExportService). Methods diverge: data(accountId, month) should be fetchReport(); empty(report) should be isEmpty() or hasInvoices(). File should be report-service.ts.
